name: Usage Meter
description: Dark, minimal plan-usage panel with four accessible quota meters (bandwidth, invocations, image optimization, build minutes). Meters hydrate from data-used/data-limit attributes, animate to their values, and flag near-limit state in text — ideal for billing and account settings pages.
features: near-limit state communicated in text, not color alone
refresh action with aria-busy and spin feedback
single teal accent on near-black with hairline borders
